notes.title: The game becomes free
notes.content:
Guys, I decided to make the game free and I have a few reasons for that:
1. The game doesn't make money anymore. Not because nobody buys it, but because most banks don't accept incoming foreign currency transfers anymore.  Yes, of course there are banks that still do, but almost all of them have some big BUT, and frankly, I don't want to go to another country for $100 a half a year or pay a 50% commission.
2. The game has broken Achievements and I can't fix them because I don't have the original build anymore.
3. I'm working on a remake and a sequel to the game at the same time. I don't know when it will come out, but sooner or later it will happen.

So. it's coming soon.

Thanks to everyone who has supported the project. It was long and hard to do it alone, but it's been done, I got a lot of useful experience. I hope you also got emotions from playing my game (not only negative :) ).

notes.title: Small update
notes.content:
(+) Small fixes in many locations
(+) Changed the mechanics of the jumping sphere
(+) Jumping without holding the spacebar
(+) Added the ability to change the direction of attack with a sword during a combo
(+) Fixed a rare bug due to which the character was stuck in the wall during double jump
(+) Fixed hitboxes of sword attack
(+) Fixed some enemy animations
(+) Added 3 additional checkpoints in the starting location
(+) Redistributed rewards in chests
(+) Added three new attacks. Upward attack, jump, and bounce.
(+) Fixed lags due to effects
(+) Completely reworked the effects
(+) Added disable effects to settings
(+) Roll now does not spend stamina
(+) Fixed roll
